summary: Ecopetrol SA filed a Form 6-K announcing the temporary suspension of a tender offer (OPAV) in Brazil by its subsidiary Ecopetrol Investimentos do Brasil Ltda., following requests for adjustments from the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM). The tender offer was initially announced on May 25, 2026. The auction is expected to resume on a date determined by the CVM once adjustments are made and approved, and all conditions precedent are satisfied. No price per share, premium, or deal value is stated. Ecopetrol will continue to update the market. What to watch: resolution of CVM requirements and resumption timeline, with risk-arb focus on regulatory conditions.
